grossIncome.title: Gross Income
grossIncome.expression: Gross Income = sum of taxable compensation components

taxFreeIncome.title: Tax-Free Income
taxFreeIncome.expression: Tax-Free Income = sum of tax-free compensation components

totalIncome.title: Total Income
totalIncome.expression: Total Income = Gross Income + Tax-Free Income

livingExpenses.title: Living Expenses
livingExpenses.expression: Living Expenses = Manual Finance carryover + location cost defaults, scaled by annual growth

taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.expression: Total Taxes = Federal Tax + State Tax

retirementSavings.title: Retirement Contributions
retirementSavings.expression: Retirement Contributions = policy-based annual contribution for the active phase

positiveSurplusInvested.title: Taxable Contributions
positiveSurplusInvested.expression: Taxable Contributions = max(Net Cash Flow, 0) × surplus investment rate

totalContributions.title: Total Contributions
totalContributions.expression: Total Contributions = Retirement Contributions + Taxable Contributions

portfolioGrowth.title: Portfolio Growth
portfolioGrowth.expression: Portfolio Growth = Prior Portfolio × assumed return rate

netCashFlow.title: Net Cash Flow
netCashFlow.expression: Net Cash Flow = Total Income - Taxes - Healthcare - Living Expenses - Investment Contributions

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.expression: Portfolio = Prior Portfolio + Portfolio Growth + Retirement Contributions + Taxable Contributions

investedPortfolio.expression: Invested Portfolio = Total Investable Assets - Cash Reserve
